title: world.index
description: The WorldIndex JSON, in parts: pushed on join by a server from before MG9 G2G; since G2G sent deflated when a client asks for it (world.index.get, after a world.index.offer).

hash.description: SHA-256 of the parts' whole text: without enc the WorldIndex JSON (what the region's shape map names); with enc its wire form (the index's hash is the offer's).

region.description: MG3 (several games): the region this message belongs to; absent = the legacy region. The client tags what it relays with its link's region; the server routes a tagged message to that region's link.

enc.description: MG9 G2G: the parts' text is Base64 of the raw-deflated UTF-8 WorldIndex JSON (sent when a client asks for it after an offer); absent: the text itself (a server from before G2G pushed it on join).
